records.question: What supply-chain risks did Apple list in its most recent annual report?

records.question: Summarize all the rules in the fraud memo.
records.answer: The fraud memo effective March 1, 2026, sets real-time card fraud rules and score bands [1][2][3][4]. The score bands are 0 to 399 for approval, 400 to 749 for step-up, and 750 and above for a decline, with analysts permitted to override a decline below 820 upon documented customer contact [3]. Overrides exceeding $5,000 require a second analyst [3]. The specific real-time rules include R-101 Velocity, which declines the sixth and later card-not-present purchase within 10 minutes and texts the customer [4]. Rule R-104 Geo-jump declines the second card-present purchase if two occur more than 500 miles apart within 2 hours and places a soft block [4]. Rule R-110 First foreign use triggers in-app verification for a first-ever foreign purchase over $400 [4]. Rule R-117 Merchant risk holds transactions for analyst review for up to 4 hours when the merchant category is high risk and the amount exceeds $250 [4]. Rule R-122 New-device spend declines purchases over $1,000 made within 24 hours of a new device enrolling and requires a Customer Care call [4]. Finally, Rule R-130 ATM pattern blocks ATM access for 24 hours after 3 or more out-of-network ATM withdrawals occur in one day at different terminals [4].
